content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-135. - Relationship to state law.
content.summary:
The provisions of this division shall be deemed supplemental to and shall not supersede
               any procedure provided by state law for limiting access to or sealing criminal justice
               records.
(Code 1981, § 2-225; Ord. No. 1905, § 5, 2-7-1983)
